rv.q: Flamenc Oh!! is a fantastic celebration of flamenco and Andalusian culture in London.

The moments that do include flamenco are brilliantly performed with passion, energy and precision; Carlos Chamorro's choreography and Tatiana de Sarabia's beautiful and vibrant costumes ensure that each routine is mesmerising and enjoyable.
There’s nothing subtle or nuanced about Flamenc Oh!! – I suppose the two exclamation marks give the game away.
This brilliantly entertaining show has something for everyone.
It is a wonderful experience that lingers long after the show finishes.
For someone who is after warm-hearted fun, packaged up with some true flamenco talent, there is much to enjoy.
What Flamenc-Oh!! does well is keep the energy going.
Unfortunately, the production does not stop there, indulging in broad physical humour and feeble slapstick.
A talented company with a worthwhile idea plays for laughs it doesn’t need.

cn.t: This flamenco comedy successfully blends technical brilliance with physical humor, though the heavy audience participation tests some patience. Critics praise the masterful dancing and musicianship while noting the show works better for flamenco fans.
